title: CreatePipelineStepRequest
description: POST /api/pipelines/:id/steps body. `type` selects which per-subtype shape `config` must conform to. `position` is OPTIONAL (HEL-410): an integer list index (0-based) into the pipeline's current position-sorted step list. Absent means append (the pre-existing behavior, unchanged); present means insert-at, validated server-side as `0 <= position <= count` (count = the pipeline's current step count; `position = count` is equivalent to append) — out-of-range values are rejected with 422 and nothing is persisted. `enabled` is OPTIONAL (HEL-412): absent (or true) creates an enabled step; `false` creates a disabled step (excluded from runs, analyze, and preview).
